problem: A page-view counter loses increments under concurrent requests
context: The app reads the counter row, adds one in application code, and writes it back. It runs as 3 instances behind a load balancer on PostgreSQL.
constraints: Must not lose increments under concurrency

options.summary: Replace read-modify-write with a single UPDATE counters SET n = n + 1 WHERE id = $1
Read the row with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE inside a transaction, then write n + 1
Wrap the read-modify-write in an in-process mutex in the application

criteria.description: No lost increments across all instances
Low contention and latency under load

expected.why: An in-process mutex doesn't coordinate across 3 instances; the atomic UPDATE is simplest and fastest.
